fetch_recipe: GET the recorded url exactly (raw Internet Archive id_ form) with no Accept-Encoding request header and no automatic decoding (for example curl -s -o FILE URL, without --compressed), then hash the bytes as received. A client that sends Accept-Encoding can receive an on-the-fly gzip body with different bytes, and a decoding client unpacks bodies that the archive stores compressed.

rows.role_title: President of the Inkatha Freedom Party
rows.text: An IFP press release dated 24 October 1995 says the shooting of six IFP candidates in Mpumalanga "comes a day before IFP President, Dr M G Buthelezi, addresses an election rally", and that the meeting to be addressed by "IFP President, Dr M G Buthelezi" will go ahead.

locator.section: Second paragraph (beginning "The ambush was carefully planned") and final paragraph (beginning "The meeting this evening")
